Reported Spill Volume: 100 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS THAT ON 6/18/24 500 GALLONS OF SODIUM HYPCHLORITE (12.5%) WERE GETTING DELIVERED BY THE SRP. AN EMPLOYEE WAS ON-SITE DURING THE DELIVERY BUT LEFT WHILE THE MATERIAL WAS BEING TRANSFERRED FROM THE VEHICLE TO A STORAGE TANK VIA A HOSE. WHEN THE EMPLOYEE RETURNED THEY WERE INFORMED BY THE SRP THAT THE MATERIAL TRANSFER WAS COMPLETE BUT THAT 50-100 GALLONS OF MATERIAL HAD RELEASED ONTO SOIL DUE TO AN OVERFILLING OF THE STORAGE TANK. NO MATERIAL RELEASED TO ANY WATERWAYS. BOTH THE SRP AND THE EMPLOYEE NEEDED TO USE AN ON-SITE EMERGENCY EYE WASH DUE TO FUMES FROM THE MATERIAL. NEITHER WERE EXPOSED TO THE LIQUID DIRECTLY. THE CALLER WAS INFORMED OF THE INCIDENT ON 6/20/24.

WHEN THE EMPLOYEE RETURNED THEY WERE INFORMED BY THE SRP THAT THE MATERIAL TRANSFER WAS COMPLETE BUT THAT 50-100 GALLONS OF MATERIAL HAD RELEASED ONTO SOIL DUE TO AN OVERFILLING OF THE STORAGE TANK. NO MATERIAL RELEASED TO ANY WATERWAYS. BOTH THE SRP AND THE EMPLOYEE NEEDED TO USE AN ON-SITE EMERGENCY EYE WASH DUE TO FUMES FROM THE MATERIAL. NEITHER WERE EXPOSED TO THE LIQUID DIRECTLY. THE CALLER WAS INFORMED OF THE INCIDENT ON 6/20/24.

THE CALLER STATES THAT IT IS UNKNOWN WHO THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY IS, BUT LOCAL FIRST RESPONDER AND RAILROAD MANAGEMENT ARE ON SCENE FOR INVESTIGATION. . SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.732444, -95.227245 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 222 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** DURING A HEAVY RAIN EVENT ON 5/11/2013, THE CITY OF GALENA PARK TEXAS RECEIVED APPROXIMATELY 8 INCHES OF RAIN FALL. ON 5/14/13, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT VEGETATION IN THE AREA OF A PORTABLE DIESEL STORAGE TANK HAD BEEN IMPACTED. UPON FURTHER INSPECTION, WHAT IS ASSUMED TO HAVE OCCURRED IS THAT THE HEAVY RAIN EVENT CAUSED DIESEL FUEL FROM THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT OF THE PORTABLE DIESEL TANK TO OVERFLOW AND SPILL ON GROUND IMPACTING THE VEGETATION IN THE AREA. THE WORST CASE AMOUNT SPILLED FROM THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT WOULD BE 222 GALS OF DIESEL FUEL ON 5/11/13 IN A 24 HOUR PERIOD. THIS IS AN EXTREMELY CONSERVATIVE ASSUMPTION; HOWEVER, KINDER MORGAN FEELS IT IS NECESSARY TO MAKE A REPORT TO THE NRC. NOTE THE APPROXIMATE SIZE OF THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT IS 8 FT BY 5 FT. ASSUMING 8 INCHES RAINFALL (0.75 FT), EQUIVALENT TO 30 FT3 OR 222 GALS. THIS ASSUMES THAT THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT WAS FULL OF DIESEL FUEL PRIOR TO THE RAINFALL OCCURRING. THERE IS NO DEFECT IN THE PORTABLE DIESEL TANK SECONDARY CONTAINMENT.
